notes: Quick reference guide (pages 7-10) read as the 2021 design's step pages: bold panel headings and bold 'Label:' lead-ins are the panels ('Treatment planning: Because of …'), except under a panel heading, whose own text they open: 'Treatment options to induce remission' holds 'Patients fit for intensive chemotherapy:', 'Patients not fit …:', 'Allogeneic stem cell transplant:' and 'Radiation therapy:' as bold lead-ins; a whole bold line ending in the colon over a list is a lead-in; 'Other treatment options' and 'Acute promyelocytic leukaemia' are two headings (the first line had room for the second's first word); a step carried over the page ('… continued') resumes at the step, so 'Research and clinical trials:' on page 9 opens its own panel.

Figure 1 (page 11), Figure 2 (page 14) and Figure A1 (page 64) are rendered figures; Figure 3 (page 24) is the timeframes table; the seven-steps box, the resource callouts (thumbnails dropped as design), the validated-tools box and the closing 'Visit our guides' band are one-cell tables.
The welcome's signatory (page 6) is one paragraph of name and role; the signature image is dropped as design; the endorsement logos on the title page leave 'Endorsed by' as text.
Contributors (pages 62-63) one entry per line under bold group headings; the closing stakeholder statement is a bold paragraph.
Body text sets '10⁹/L' flat as '109/L' in its text layer (pages 27, 7 has the superscript): kept as the PDF encodes it.
'First published in June 2016. This edition published in June 2021.' on the imprint page; second edition.
Page 87 is blank; back cover (page 88) carries only the cover artwork.
